title: Sandpiper's Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set directly along the Gulf in Seagrove Beach, this remarkable beachfront residence offers an exceptional blend of privacy, sophistication, and effortless coastal living. Private beach access leads from the pool deck straight to the sugar-white sand, creating a seamless connection between the home and the shoreline. Expansive terraces invite relaxed outdoor living, while a resort-style pool and spa provide a tranquil setting for sun-filled afternoons and evening gatherings. Seasonal beach setups further elevate the experience, allowing days on the water to unfold with ease and comfort. Inside, more than 4,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space showcases refined coastal style and generous areas for gathering. A chef-inspired kitchen anchors the home’s entertaining spaces, complemented by multiple private suites designed for comfort and relaxation. The Gulf-view primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with its own outdoor living space, perfectly positioned to capture both sunrise and sunset along the water. An elevator connects each level of the home, while included bicycles and a golf cart make exploring the charm of 30A simple and enjoyable.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 1 - First Floor: Double + Double Over Double Bunk
